description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class for file formatter plugins in Drupal, providing base functionality for linking to file download URLs and handling formatter settings.

classes.name: BaseFieldFileFormatterBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for file field formatters, enabling linking to file URLs and managing formatter settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the formatter with dependencies, including the file URL generator.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default settings for the formatter, such as whether to link to the file.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for the formatter, allowing configuration of linking behavior.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for each field item, optionally linking to the file URL.

methods.name: viewValue
methods.description: Abstract method to generate display output for a single field item.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the formatter is applicable to a given field definition, specifically for 'file' entity types.
